# Synthetic Pipeline Overview
The synthetic-relay and synthetic-ledger systems form a data flow where the ledger stores events for relay consumption, while the relay reads those events without writing to them.

## Member Excerpts
*   [[wiki/synthetic-relay.md|synthetic-relay]]: Reads events from the Synthetic Ledger but does not write to it.
*   [[wiki/synthetic-ledger.md|synthetic-ledger]]: Stores events for the synthetic-relay to read; no source describes an archive of these events.
